title: SHN extern talent pool closes Nov 30 (format C)

slides.title: scarborough health's extern talent pool closes nov 30

slides.label: extern notes 📝
slides.title: wait, what's a talent pool?
slides.body: the posting says it builds a candidate pool for upcoming vacancies. it isn't a specific open job.

mark.phrase: it isn't a specific open job

slides.title: who can apply
slides.body: BScN students in year 3 or final year, with current BCLS and evidence of excellent academic standing.

slides.title: before you apply
slides.body: check your year and program, make sure your BCLS is current, have proof of your academic standing ready and screenshot your confirmation.

slides.title: looking for more extern postings?
slides.body: ontarioexterns.ca: Ontario extern postings, checked on each hospital's own careers page.

caption.text:
Scarborough Health Network’s Clinical Nurse Extern posting is a talent pool: it builds a candidate pool for upcoming vacancies and is not a specific vacant position. It closes Nov 30, 2026. BScN year 3 or final year, current BCLS, $25.379/hr (as posted). Full requirements are on SHN’s posting.

ontarioexterns.ca is our own independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital.
